related.title: ROADM 串接：濾波器通帶收縮
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：由另一學徒只使用交付檔案重建兩情境與判定；需同時保留未通過情境。 教學OSNR至少22 dB；4段通過、8段不足；多段不等增益時必須改用逐段模型。 span_noise.csv、線性功率總和與頻寬定義 保留輸入、逐項中間值、名義 23.9794 與變更 20.9691 dB、反例、驗收判定與模型限制，供另一學徒從零重算。 附離線證據實驗：python3 tools/curriculum-v28/labs-optical.py --lab comm-v28-156 --out ./comm-v28-156-evidence；輸出目錄必須尚不存在。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: A second apprentice must reconstruct both scenarios and decisions using only the handover files; retain failing cases as well. Teaching minimum OSNR22 dB:4 spans pass and8 fail; unequal gains require a span-by-span model. span_noise.csv, linear power sums and bandwidth definitions Preserve inputs, intermediate values, nominal 23.9794 and changed 20.9691 dB, counterexamples, acceptance decisions and model limits so another apprentice can reproduce them. Offline evidence lab: python3 tools/curriculum-v28/labs-optical.py --lab comm-v28-156 --out ./comm-v28-156-evidence; the output directory must not already exist.
related.difference: 完成兩組條件的可重算判定，指出哪些觀察能區分原因。 教學訊號需40 GHz完整通帶；4級模型可行、9級不足；只在高斯模型內作此結論。
related.differenceEn: Produce reproducible decisions for both configurations and identify observations that discriminate causes. Teaching signal needs40 GHz passband:4 modeled stages suffice and9 do not; the conclusion is limited to the Gaussian model.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 合成單段OSNR為30 dB、同一參考頻寬；比較4與8等效段，不計非線性雜訊。 名義式 30-10*log10(4) = 23.9794 dB；變更式 30-10*log10(8) = 20.9691 dB。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 將每段雜訊轉線性相加後回dB；把參考頻寬與訊號量測頻寬單獨列出。
合成單級高斯功率3dB頻寬100 GHz；比較4與9級，頻率中心完全對齊。 名義式 100/sqrt(4) = 50 GHz；變更式 100/sqrt(9) = 33.3333 GHz。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 在等效半功率點逐級乘透射率確認總功率1/2；不要把振幅高斯和功率高斯混用。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Synthetic single-span OSNR30 dB in the same reference bandwidth; compare4 and8 equivalent spans, neglecting nonlinear noise. Nominal 30-10*log10(4) = 23.9794 dB; changed 30-10*log10(8) = 20.9691 dB. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Sum linear noise powers then return to dB; distinguish the noise reference bandwidth from signal integration bandwidth.

Synthetic single-stage Gaussian power3 dB bandwidth100 GHz; compare4 and9 centered stages. Nominal 100/sqrt(4) = 50 GHz; changed 100/sqrt(9) = 33.3333 GHz. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Multiply stage power transmissions at the predicted half-power frequency and recover1/2; distinguish amplitude and power Gaussian definitions.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: 10G-EPON：突發保護時間的效率成本
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：由另一學徒只使用交付檔案重建兩情境與判定；需同時保留未通過情境。 教學OSNR至少22 dB；4段通過、8段不足；多段不等增益時必須改用逐段模型。 span_noise.csv、線性功率總和與頻寬定義 保留輸入、逐項中間值、名義 23.9794 與變更 20.9691 dB、反例、驗收判定與模型限制，供另一學徒從零重算。 附離線證據實驗：python3 tools/curriculum-v28/labs-optical.py --lab comm-v28-156 --out ./comm-v28-156-evidence；輸出目錄必須尚不存在。

Offline evidence lab: python3 tools/curriculum-v28/labs-optical.py --lab comm-v28-156 --out ./comm-v28-156-evidence; the output directory must not already exist.
related.difference: 完成兩組條件的可重算判定，指出哪些觀察能區分原因。 教學時間效率至少0.95；32組通過、64組不足；禁止為追效率直接刪除必要保護時間。
related.differenceEn: Produce reproducible decisions for both configurations and identify observations that discriminate causes. Teaching efficiency minimum0.95:32 passes and64 fails; required guard time must not simply be removed to improve a ratio.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 合成單段OSNR為30 dB、同一參考頻寬；比較4與8等效段，不計非線性雜訊。 名義式 30-10*log10(4) = 23.9794 dB；變更式 30-10*log10(8) = 20.9691 dB。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 將每段雜訊轉線性相加後回dB；把參考頻寬與訊號量測頻寬單獨列出。

合成1 ms輪、32突發，各1 µs保護；變更64突發，輪長不變。 名義式 (1000-32*1)/1000 = 0.968 time efficiency；變更式 (1000-64*1)/1000 = 0.936 time efficiency。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 在時間軸排列突發與保護區，總長應等於1 ms；驗證最後一段未越輪界。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Synthetic single-span OSNR30 dB in the same reference bandwidth; compare4 and8 equivalent spans, neglecting nonlinear noise. Nominal 30-10*log10(4) = 23.9794 dB; changed 30-10*log10(8) = 20.9691 dB. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Sum linear noise powers then return to dB; distinguish the noise reference bandwidth from signal integration bandwidth.

Synthetic1 ms cycle with32 bursts and1 µs guard each; change to64 bursts at fixed cycle duration. Nominal (1000-32*1)/1000 = 0.968 time efficiency; changed (1000-64*1)/1000 = 0.936 time efficiency. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Lay out bursts and guards on a timeline summing to1 ms and check the last interval against the cycle boundary.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
